thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: p99 streaming latency surge for customer Meridian. Current p99 2.3s (SLO 600ms). Affected routes: /v1/stream, model: redwood-llama-13b-qlora. -- alert id: alert-1749
oncall-alex: Acked. I'm on it. What's the customer impact? Any 5xxs?
maria-sre: Seeing increase in stalled streaming frames, not necessarily 5xx, but long stalls reported by client. Error rate normal. Latency heatmaps show tail at backend decode stage.
jay-eng: Logs show repeated KV cache evictions on dedupe-shard-7 around the same time. High-entropy prefixes from Meridian are creating heavy per-session cache growth.
pri-plat: Meridian is single-tenant on dedicated pool dpool-meridian-1. Autoscale didn't trigger; pool at 80% GPU util.
oncall-alex: Can we throttle long prefixes or fall back to non-streaming path for this tenant? Need mitigation asap.
liz-cust-succ: Meridian reported degraded UX for streaming chat, particularly long form responses, customer on live call.
maria-sre: Running quick check: top sessions by prefix len:
```
session 94f3 - prefix_tokens 24k
session aab2 - prefix_tokens 18k
session 33bc - prefix_tokens 16k
```
These are outliers.
jay-eng: That explains KV cache thrash. We can evict prefixes > 8k tokens for this tenant as emergency mitigation. Patch ready, can push config to route policy.
pri-plat: Pushing policy: `route.policy.meridian.prefix_limit=8192` to dpool-meridian-1. Applying now.
incident-bot: Deploy started by pri-plat at 2025-11-03T14:12:05Z. CI checks pass.
oncall-alex: Rolling this on tenant first, then globally if ok.
maria-sre: After policy applied, observed p99 drop to 720ms within 90s. Streaming stalls reduced but still not at SLO.
jay-eng: Also noticed concurrency spike: Meridian had 1.8x expected concurrent sessions due to batch job. We can enable temporary circuit-breaker to cap concurrent sessions to 600.
pri-plat: Circuit-breaker config `tenant.meridian.max_concurrent_sessions=600` applied.
liz-cust-succ: Customer confirmed performance improved but asks for root cause and ETA for full fix.
oncall-alex: For ongoing work: engineering to add prefix-length-based admission and KV cache accounting. Can we schedule a canary fix for hotpath kernel selection?
jay-eng: Plan: 1) Add prefix accounting to cache (PR ready), 2) Add admission to serving runtime, 3) Extend autoscale policy to consider session count. ETA: 48 hours for canary, 5 days for full rollout.
maria-sre: Opening incident tracking ticket INC-2025-678 in ops board. Adding impact: 1 customer (Meridian), approx 30% of sessions degraded, no 5xxs.
oncall-alex: Handoff to day shift: @maria-sre will own mitigations and followups. @jay-eng to lead root cause and remediation. @pri-plat to validate autoscale tuning.
incident-bot: On-call handoff scheduled at 2025-11-03T18:00Z. Pager duty: next oncall is samantha.
samantha: Taking handoff. Thanks. Any outstanding actions I should be aware of?
maria-sre: Monitor p99 for 30m, verify no regressions. Postmortem template filled, need logs and timeline.
jay-eng: I'll attach PR diffs and perf bench results to the ticket.
liz-cust-succ: I'll update Meridian with the timeline and confirm acceptance of mitigations.
oncall-alex: Closing page for now but keeping thread open. Add any new regressions here.
